column2: Mirandized at 6:25 PM by one record; the sheriff describes learning of him at 8:02 PM. The gap between those two timestamps is where the discovery questions live.
Landscaping removed and ground paved within days of the shooting. Whether that erased ballistic and trace evidence is the question; whether it was done in order to is a separate one.
One page stating what the majority of citizen investigators had concluded by July 2026 about what killed Charlie Kirk, and what did not. The hinge the rest of the case turns on.
A gag order issued on the court's own motion, requested by neither side, restricting what parties and counsel may say. Lawful censorship, and a shaping force on everything published since.

The affidavit tracks a suspect across campus almost entirely on university cameras, yet only grainy re-encoded clips have reached the public. The original DVR exports and their per-frame timestamps have not.

A Utah drone-industry veteran was reportedly photographed in the crowd holding a controller, and a Heber City flight thread runs toward a Tennessee explosives maker. Presence only — no claim he flew anything at UVU.

Butler 2024 and UVU 2025 share a rooftop-gunman account and an unexplained drone question. Notes from one long call reportedly attribute a same-group, same-drones working theory to the counterterrorism center — recorded as an allegation, not a finding.
The routing memo for every drone thread — military ISR, event B-roll, and weaponized hypotheses, sorted by what is documented and what is only claimed. Read it before judging any single sighting.

Armed quadcopters are documented in Gaza; nothing places one over Orem. The page keeps the technology real and the Utah application unproven, and states the conspiracy-rhetoric risk out loud rather than trading on it.

A 150 mph pass at fifty meters lasts under a second, which is why eyewitness drone counts run from zero to sixteen. The page separates streak claims on phone video from the one drone anybody admits flew.
An Army HADES jet made low passes over Orem at 9:16 AM and again at 12:48 PM — about twenty-five minutes after the shooting. Analysts read drop and recovery; no mission order has been released.

Two named platforms — a tube-launched loitering munition and a 2–5 kg DARPA airframe — are routed to a glide path near Provo by flight geometry alone. Public Army programs make it doctrinally plausible; no record places either at UVU.

A cease-and-desist letter reportedly conceded what the public statements denied: a media drone flew for B-roll before the event while the protective detail had none. Media got the aerial view; security did not.
Six campus officers, perimeter duty, and no security drone — that is the documented deployment for September 10. The university runs its own drone program; it was not used to protect the event.
The hub for airspace as evidence: an Army ISR jet over campus, a media drone TPUSA later acknowledged, and counter-drone testing at Provo the same week. Documented flights first, theories last.

The July 2026 post is preserved unedited so it can be read without paraphrase, then assessed line by line. Real physics terms, author-drawn diagrams, and not one field strength, current estimate, or record.

One sentence names an Army proving ground as the source of the expertise — with no person, unit, date, or document behind it. The page treats capability and involvement as the different things they are.

A single X account argues the corded microphone completed a circuit and the venue itself did the rest. It is documented here for completeness and weighed against the exploding-mic finding most citizen investigators hold.

The claim is that the courtyard was the weapon — bowl geometry, an air-gapped stage, an underground tap. Every one is an ordinary venue feature reinterpreted, and the removed dirt fits a rival theory just as well.
The state's own ATF laboratory could not tie the recovered fragment to the recovered rifle. An inconclusive result on the one piece of metal meant to prove the case is not a technicality.

If the Mauser chain fails on match, energy, or trajectory, closer and lower-energy mechanisms move into frame — 9mm at the tent, corner-fired weapons, non-rifle devices. Attributed theories, not adjudicated facts.
A .30-06 carries roughly eight times the muzzle energy of a common handgun round. Ballistics commentators argue the wound described publicly does not match what that energy does at distance.
The rooftop sits 150 yards east and about 5 to 9 degrees above the stage. Analysts argue the reported wound track does not fit that line, which is why so much work moved to the microphone.
The open-source investigator who put aircraft at the centre of this case — ADS-B tracks, altitude and speed profiles, departure fields. The page also documents where his claims cut against him.
If a more sophisticated operation did the killing, some people may have been used to draw attention or absorb blame. Compiled as unproven allegations, with a legal disclaimer that means what it says.
The first-hours description — dark hat, flag shirt, dark jeans, a stiff right-leg gait — set against the man eventually charged. A witness says the photo he was shown was someone else.
Digital forensics sealed, discovery under protective order, hearings closed, autopsy withheld. What the sealing holds back is exactly the raw material that would settle how Charlie Kirk was killed.
A fixed pump camera on I-15 pins the southbound drive at roughly 7:15 AM on September 11 — one of the few hard timestamps in a contested chain. Card paid at the pump, trash cans reportedly untouched.

A worker at 785 College Drive reportedly described a man in a black trench coat and tactical gear, matching early dispatch language rather than the later T-shirt imagery. Officers reportedly showed the crew a photo that did not match.

Six hours after the shooting the accused was reportedly on restaurant CCTV at 6:38 PM, calm, seventeen minutes from campus. Timeline builders use the pin to test whether the affidavit's movement chain actually closes.

The Provo courtroom where a judge seated four months before the killing hears State v. Robinson, and where the December 2025 gag order issued on the court's own motion. A venue and an information bottleneck at once.

A photo of Goat Island was reportedly the desktop background on the seized computer, and Valhalla Danish House sits down the road from it. A Grok reply called the pairing unverified coincidence; both readings are kept here.

The routing memo for every address in the case — crime scene, drive south, surrender, jail, courthouse — separating confirmed record locations from reported-claim ones. Read it before treating any pin as decisive.

A parcel beside the wooded recovery strip is named in OSINT threads as tied to a data-analytics firm — sometimes spelled Palentire, sometimes Palantir. No deed has been produced, and no company is accused of anything.

The airfield ten minutes from campus, where a badge-access list was reportedly updated the day after the shooting and an Egypt-registered Falcon had sat since September 4. Reported questions, not established facts.
The courtyard itself: tent stage, hybrid security, the 12:23 PM shot, and the paving that followed within days. The location page for the crime scene, with the mechanism argued elsewhere.
Charlie Kirk was pronounced dead here after a hasty transport by SUV rather than a lighted ambulance. Reviewers ask why a Level IV trauma centre, and why not the closer, more capable hospital.

Two southern-Utah addresses, 250 miles from campus: a St. George apartment and the Washington City family home where the surrender was arranged. Whether the party stopped at the apartment first is still open.
Who owns the ground the rifle was reportedly recovered beside? The question came from a researcher note rather than a deed, and this page holds it open until a Utah County record answers it.
Booking 460956, restricted housing, suicide watch, and hearings by video feed from Spanish Fork. The custody endpoint that makes phone seizure, Miranda, and message timing testable.
A Danish house down the road from Goat Island, and an FBI director's press-conference line about seeing a friend in Valhalla. The page keeps the coincidence and the debunk side by side.

The Hurricane office where the accused arrived with his parents, sat unrestrained with water, and was never questioned by the county. Federal and state investigators took custody around 2 AM and drove north.

A scoped Mauser .30-06, reportedly wrapped in a dark towel, found in trees north of campus after earlier sweeps and a K-9 pass reportedly found nothing. The state's whole theory rests on that recovery.

Every murder investigation eventually becomes a map. The confirmed pins — courtyard, hospital, woods, Dairy Queen, Maverik, Hurricane, Spanish Fork — are weighed here against the disputed parcels and the airport threads.
Once the manhunt ended, press value moved from who shot him to what the state can prove and what stays sealed. A running index of the trial coverage, outlet by outlet.

Two different claims get blurred together: that no autopsy happened, and that one happened and the report was never released. The second is the accurate one, and it is why almost nothing here is settled.
Forensics does not stop at the body. The tent ground was reportedly paved or hardscaped within days, which is a problem for wound-origin reconstruction and trace recovery either way.

A Tennessee explosives maker whose federal contract list reportedly includes miniature XS demolition devices, anti-personnel. A paralegal pulled it from USASpending.gov; the plant was destroyed about a month after September 10.

A former Marine breacher argues the charge sat in the crucifix pendant rather than the microphone — same effects, different object. Presented as that author's analysis and set against the mic version.
Two independent cameras, one running 60 frames a second, are read as showing shirt fabric expanding outward before any wound appears. Analysts also track a small black object leaving the neck area.

The lavalier clipped to his shirt may have concealed a small explosive — the leading conclusion among citizen investigators, and the thread that runs through video, audio, procurement, and post-event debris.

A Heber City drone-industry veteran photographed near Charlie Kirk before the event and grouped in aftermath commentary threads. Documented as a witness to the response, not as an accused participant.
The construction worker whose reported description — black trench coat, cargo pants, long hair — matches early dispatch language and not the man later charged. Recorded as a witness account only.
Feet from the stage, then in the SUV during transport — and reportedly the man who warned about building exposure after reviewing drone footage. He publicly refutes the theories that name him.
The UVU police chief who fielded roughly six officers, about a quarter of his department, with no rooftop sweep and no campus drone. TPUSA's detail lead has publicly criticised that planning.
A statement-versus-document index for the FBI director: what he said publicly in the first days, set beside the filings and booking records that came later. The dispute is recorded as a dispute.
The TPUSA officer whose public framing of drones and security is measured here against what the organization later acknowledged. Documented statements, with no claim of foreknowledge.

A Bombardier Global 6500 flown by an Army ISR contractor, callsign AXLE10, ran an unusual low and slow profile near Orem on September 10. No track, tasking order, or sensor product from it has appeared in the prosecution.
About a dozen lieutenant colonels on base September 8, a VIP flight out on the 9th, and UVU-linked figures reportedly photographed there the same week. Timing indicators, stacked and dated.
The 48 to 72 hours before UVU, laid out as a pressure chronology rather than an accusation. Context for the intelligence theories, and explicitly not proof that any agency ordered anything.
Public ADS-B puts an Army HADES jet in extremely low, slow passes near UVU before and after 12:23 PM. The master file's summary of it runs to four words: it was ours.

Egyptian-linked contractors reportedly tested counter-drone gear at Provo the week of the killing, on U.S. DoD Liaison badges and a clearance to skip screening. Ten minutes from campus, and unverified.

Broadcast audio at 48 kHz reportedly separates a distant muzzle blast from a louder event about 46 meters away at the stage. Two sounds, two distances — and the fatal mechanism may not be the rooftop rifle.

If the rooftop chain fails on ballistics, audio, identity, and timing, investigators need somewhere to route. This page is that switchboard — every alternative, each labelled a hypothesis rather than a finding.
Arm-to-arm sweeps found nothing. A K-9 pass found nothing. Then federal agents reportedly sent three junior local officers back over the same ground, and the rifle appeared.
Backpack fullness, headwear, and trouser colour differ between the man tracked across campus and the figure filmed on the stairs. If they are two people, the charging narrative has no shooter.
A 5 to 9 degree downward path from 120 meters east should strike face or jaw first. The reported entry is between larynx and trachea, nearly straight on — geometry that analysts say does not close.

The hub for every reported reason the rooftop account may fail — ballistics, wounds, acoustics, cameras, custody timing. Robinson is charged, not convicted, and this is the case the state has not had to answer.

No counter-snipers, no Secret Service layer, and a last-minute private detail — against a courtyard ringed by rooftops. The capability most directly matched to the government's own account was the one absent.

Six campus officers, no thorough rooftop inspection, and a prone all-black figure reportedly on the same roof an hour before the shot. The clearest physical security failure under any theory of the killing.

Credentials were reportedly revoked for one group of affiliates, yet a member of it stood in the Q&A line and asked the final question. The page asks who let him in, and claims nothing beyond the record.

Rooftop, tent line, van, tunnel — every proposed origin for the shot, tested against sight lines, acoustics, and the affidavit clock. If the mechanism was a device at the podium, no shooter position explains the wound.
Structure, leadership, security arrangements, donors, and internal dynamics — the organizational context around the event, with no claim that TPUSA is responsible for the killing.
The ground directly under Charlie Kirk, where grass was ripped out and pavers laid within days. None of that ground work has been accounted for in the state's case.
The map of the main theories — foreign intelligence, agency scope, device hypotheses — each linked to its own claim page. Read it as a routing table, not an endorsement.

Midnight to midnight in Mountain time: the pre-dawn aircraft picture, camera sightings from 8:07 to 11:49 AM, the 12:23:30 shot, the SUV run, the evening manhunt. Every line labelled reported or claimed.
Doorbell, traffic, and campus cameras stitched into a movement chain, then tested against drive times. The southbound leg to St. George is where the timing questions get sharpest.
The hub for the official suspect — identity mismatches, surrender timeline, the messages, ballistics, family, trial, and the patsy theories. Charged, not convicted.
Wound morphology, trajectory, and energy against a Mauser at 120 meters — and a state ballistics report that cannot tie the fragment to the rifle. The central argument that the rifle account fails.

A reported closed-door meeting of roughly a dozen lieutenant colonels, a VIP jet in and out, and a walk-in witness who says he was detained — all inside thirty-six hours before September 10. None of it appears in the state's case.

HADES is a real, publicly contracted Army ISR program built on the same Global 6500 airframe as N1098L. Defense-trade reporting separately describes Army interest in launching drones from that airframe.

The NCTC director says on the record that his center's parallel review of foreign ties was ordered to stop once a suspect was in custody — before the leads were exhausted. The most senior official to say the inquiry was cut short.
Nearly the whole public case for the accused's movements is built from cameras — doorbells, campus CCTV, crowd phones, production rigs, travel-stop recorders. This is the device-by-device index.
UVU is both the crime scene and an institution with its own account to give — security decisions, camera holdings, evidence handling. The university-response index.
What is and is not established about the accused's own devices — reported extractions, location and tower metadata, and the discovery the defence says it has not received.
The judge presiding over State v. Robinson, appointed in May 2025 to a bench vacated that August. His public court actions are documented here; nothing beyond them is alleged.
The docket as a record: judges, defence and prosecution teams, hearing days, ballistics fights, sealing motions. Where every claim on this site eventually has to meet a filing.
Booking 460956 in Spanish Fork, restricted housing, remote appearances, and the jailhouse-informant process questions that follow from all three.
